Preview, News-first homepage

One homepage that shows what is new, what was delivered, and what is worth tracking next.

This concept turns the front page into a lightweight newsroom for VAN. It keeps the strategy and public metrics visible, while adding a dedicated stream for product updates, periodic reports, infrastructure milestones, and notable portfolio-related announcements.

Update

Homepage now includes a chronological news stream for public updates

The front-page concept was extended with a structured feed so visitors can immediately see what changed recently, what was published, and which milestones matter. This creates a clearer cadence for communication and gives future reports a natural place on the site.

08 Apr 2026
Report

Weekly performance summary format prepared for public reporting

A compact report card can summarize weekly return, realized drawdown, market conditions, and the main operational notes. This allows future reporting posts to stay short on the homepage while linking deeper into a full write-up when needed.

Release

Public site architecture remains isolated from the authenticated application

The preview keeps the safe split between public content and the authorized portal. It can be iterated independently and promoted later without touching the trading app, backtester, or internal operator pages.

Update

News entries can also highlight research notes and investor-facing commentary

Besides platform releases, the feed can carry short notes on strategy observations, infrastructure milestones, reporting cadence, and public communication milestones. That makes the homepage useful even between larger product changes.
